description: Signed DHT interest claim (avalon_protocol::interest_claim) minted as the subscribe-handshake payload once a chat websocket's node_info hello tells the client which base_url to bind to (crates/server/src/chat.rs's NodeInfo message). Each supporting SDK must derive byte-for-byte identical signing bytes, an identical Ed25519 signature, and the identical wire JSON shape sent in a subscribe_channel/subscribe_conversation message's `claim` field.

notSupported.rust: crates/sdk's websocket subscribe methods (Session::subscribe_presence in social.rs, GuildChannel's subscribe in guilds.rs, Conversation's subscribe in conversations.rs) send only a bare {type: subscribe, ...} message with no node_info handshake and no signed interest claim at all — avalon_protocol::interest_claim exists and is used server-side, but crates/sdk never calls it. Real gap, not just untested.
notSupported.csharp: bindings/csharp/AvalonSdk has no websocket subscribe support on AccountSession at all (Session.cs/Social.cs's websocket code is the older, integrator-facing Session type, which itself has no interest-claim handshake either). Real gap, not just untested.
